name: Sta★Gra -Star Graduation-
source:
2027. Aliens came to the Earth and for a year a group of them will study as international students for a year. They aren't much different from humans apart of some features like wings and tails - and they have special abilities. Main hero is student council chairman and he needs to help them socialize.

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.ru/2017/10/vn-of-month-october-1999.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
2027年，外星人来到地球，其中一群外星人将以留学生身份在这里学习一年。除了翅膀、尾巴等特征以及特殊能力外，他们与人类并没有太大不同。男主人公是学生会主席，需要帮助他们融入社会。

[摘自[url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.ru/2017/10/vn-of-month-october-1999.html]vndbreview[/url]]
